docs.dcterms_abstract: Vegelin reports that he summoned the steward because revenues are lacking. Several farmers still owe several years of lease. Commander Rennese and his wife and several other members of the knighthood complain about their poverty. Vegelin is going to Liesfelt to oversee the land lease and church revenues. [Milo van de Pol]

Vegelin will travel to Dietz to confer with Hohenfelt. [Milo van de Pol]
